answer: Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own bridge record, and its own share of the pigment quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The ocean ledger enforces the limit at intake. The nonce chain allows at most 2 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. A farm of 4823 identities would post 1862 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
